name: Tens
install:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm use 22 >/dev/null
export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 22)"):$PATH"
corepack enable
yarn install --frozen-lockfile
yarn playwright install --with-deps chromium
start:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm use 22 >/dev/null
export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 22)"):$PATH"
yarn dev
